examples.english: But he, not even lifting his head as he wove the palms, said to me in a firm voice: “He to whom you have given this knows its amount; there is no need for anyone to tell him the quantity. For He who weighs mountains and hills with a scale is not ignorant of the quantity of silver. If you had told me this, you would have done well to remind me, for I am a man; but when you have given it to God, what need is there to inform me? For the God who accepted the widow’s two small coins will also accept your offering. But you should be silent, lest you boast.”
